source: RENKAN round-1 triage (5 lenses) vs head e335ab7+campaign

findings.title: ?entry=shelf summons the operator debug strip which swallows taps
findings.evidence: Commit d6d5c91 'corridor: ?entry=shelf is a front door, not a debug switch' (ancestor of HEAD). Current code prototypes/corridor/corridor.js:1787-1799 iterates VARIANTS keys but explicitly excludes 'entry' from setting anyVariantParam ('if (key !== "entry") anyVariantParam = true;'), with an in-code comment citing the three review lanes; the strip is now reachable only via explicit ?variants=1. The same fix is present in the rebuilt corridor-standalone.html (grep for the 'must never summon' comment hits).
findings.note: The debug strip itself still exists (renderVariants at corridor.js:10378) but is opt-in only.

findings.title: 30 finished Bunki originals stranded on unmerged codex branches, shelf stuck at 40
findings.evidence: prototypes/corridor/data/articles/index.json now lists 70 articles (verified by parsing), 30 of them carrying the 検収前 provenance flag; every id has a body file on disk. Landed via commits 1606a1e 'feat: re-land native readings' and 774f1dc 'recovered 30: visible 検収前 provenance flags + authored English titles', merged to main through PR #73 (merge commit e335ab7) — the 'no PR' complaint is also resolved.

findings.title: Standalone single-file build lacks the 30 new articles
findings.evidence: Commit 49efa25 'standalone: rebuild after TITLES_EN addition' regenerated prototypes/corridor/corridor-standalone.html. Verified in the current file: all 30 検収前-flagged article ids are present, and a sampled body text snippet (朝の図書館で『古事記』を開くと…) is embedded, confirming bodies — not just index entries — are bundled.

findings.title: Revlog is written 'for the FSRS optimizer' but nothing reads it
findings.evidence: Every S.revlog reference in current corridor.js is load/persist or append: load at 954, persist at 982, grade-row append at 6279-6283 (commitStandardGrade), undo-revocation append at 6835-6836. No optimizer, analytics, forecast, or replay consumer reads the rows anywhere in the repo; the only other revlog code is shape validation in tools/verify-corridor-storage-integrity.mjs (an integrity test, not a consumer). FSRS parameters remain population defaults from the pin.

findings.title: Session time budget hardcoded at 12 minutes, no UI for the learner's chosen time
findings.evidence: apps/app/src/screens/session-screen.tsx:83 still has 'timeBudgetMin = 12' as the prop default, and the only caller, apps/app/app/(session)/session.tsx (SessionScreen invocation at ~lines 42-55), never passes timeBudgetMin — it only sets newBudget for the guided route. No settings/picker UI for the budget exists anywhere in apps/app.

findings.title: Lookup-friction channel (T-07) fires only on the scripted golden route
findings.evidence: The only dispatcher of the recordLookupFriction command outside store plumbing and tests is still apps/app/src/data/golden-source.ts:193-201 (goldenLookupCommand). Grep over all apps/app/src/**/*.tsx screens finds zero dispatches; the command exists in store.ts:283/452 and memory-store.ts:692/1172 but no real lookup surface calls it, so real learners' lookups still record nothing.

findings.title: Two divergent contract-creation lineages (validated activateLearn vs compatibility mint)
findings.evidence: bootstrapSessionWorkspace in apps/app/src/screens/session-loop.ts still branches: durableContractsFor (line 497, fed by the activateLearn path that only golden-source.ts:204-211 dispatches) versus the explicitly-labelled 'Compatibility for existing callers' mint at lines 506-527, which calls contractsFor and falls back to readingContractIdFor(lexeme) id shapes ('contract-reading-<lexeme>', line 136) — a different contract-id shape from golden-source's learnContractIdentity(threadId, spec, skill). The code comment concedes 'The A1 source route never reaches this branch', i.e. ordinary sessions still take the unvalidated lineage.

findings.title: Corridor enables FSRS fuzz against the domain determinism pin; fuzzOff has no UI or writer
findings.evidence: prototypes/corridor/corridor.js:1937-1947 still passes enable_fuzz: S.stats?.fuzzOff === true ? false : true — fuzz ON by default, with an in-code comment acknowledging it 'deliberately diverging from the domain pin's false'. The domain pin remains FSRS_ENABLE_FUZZ = false (packages/domain/src/reducers/fsrs-pin.ts:90). fuzzOff is still only a stored-value validator (corridor.js:784) and a test fixture (tools/verify-corridor-storage-integrity.mjs:262); no UI and no code anywhere writes it.
findings.note: The divergence is now documented as deliberate in a comment (replay stays deterministic via the seeded fuzz), but the ledger's finding — divergence from the pin plus an unreachable opt-out flag — is unchanged in code.

findings.title: AI chat capped at 24 turns; word-tutor / examples / coach / quiz persist nothing
findings.evidence: prototypes/corridor/corridor.js:989 still persists 'aiChat: state.aiChat.slice(-24)' — turn 25 destroys turn 1. The tutor quiz is declared 'in-memory only' (comment at line 537). The word-tutor (7785-7790), examples (7823), and coach/reading surfaces (7867-7871, 7929) all write replies to out.textContent only and never call saveStore for the exchange; no archive (no IndexedDB, no ailog) exists in the file.

findings.title: No graph memory: flat {role,text} pairs, no ids/timestamps/metadata/edges; learner model one scalar
findings.evidence: S.aiChat is still documented and stored as flat pairs — comment at corridor.js:535 '[{ role: "user"|"tutor", text }]', and pushes at 4256 and 4269 write exactly {role, text} with no id, timestamp, model metadata, or edges to the vocab/kanji/grammar in scope. The learner model remains the modal-JLPT scalar computed at corridor.js:7740-7747. No graph-memory structure exists anywhere in the repo.

findings.title: Deployed AI calls have no timeout or abort; the engineered 10s-abort runtime serves no traffic
findings.evidence: aiConverse at prototypes/corridor/corridor.js:7749-7774 is a bare fetch to api.anthropic.com with no AbortController, no signal, and no timeout — a stalled request still leaves 考え中… (set at 4260, 7787, etc.) until the socket dies. The abort-capable runtime still exists unused in packages/ai/src/runtime.ts (controller at line 134, signal linking at 268); the corridor imports nothing from @bunki/ai.

findings.title: Drift flick judgments dead-end in bunki-drift-v1 store
findings.evidence: Commit 02188af (分流の橋 P0, ancestor of HEAD). corridor.js:1086-1088 defines window.bunkiDriftJudgment = (kind,key,dir) => obsLog('drift', srsKey(...), dir>0?3:1); drift-layer.js:1744 calls it after each committed flick grade. obslog is persisted/exported with kairo-corridor-v1 (storeEnvelope, corridor.js:975-983) and obslog row shape validated at corridor.js:731.
findings.note: Fixed as designed: judgments land in the observation ledger as exposure evidence, deliberately NOT minting FSRS state (constitution: exposure is not mastery). If the campaign expects flicks to reach FSRS directly, that remains unbuilt by intent.

findings.title: Dojo kanji mode mints orphaned FSRS state and burns new-card slots
findings.evidence: Commit 6dc03f4 (道場の礼 P0, ancestor of HEAD). corridor.js:6695-6721: grade handler computes isDrillOnly = S.focus && prevRec===undefined && item not in S.taken, and routes to commitDrillGrade (corridor.js:6271-6276) which writes ONLY an obslog row ['dojo', skey, rating] — no S.srs write, no revlog row, no S.stats nnew increment. Non-drill grades still use commitStandardGrade (6278-6294).

findings.title: Galaxy chrome taps leak to open-water handler and raze constellation
findings.evidence: Commit ac880af (分流の岸 P1, ancestor). corridor.js:1090-1093 exports window.bunkiDriftChrome selector listing every fused ginga element (#ginga-symbol, #ginga-theme-seal, .ginga-seal, .nav-scrim, .nav-bar, .corner-bubble, .world-picker, .world-picker-scrim, #variants, #chrome). drift-layer.js:21 defines hostChrome(t) via closest(); guards at drift-layer.js:2215 (ripple) and 2320 (pointerup/flick handler): if(hostChrome(e.target)) return.

findings.title: No visible way out of a galaxy dive
findings.evidence: Commit 4032235 (深さの橋 P1, ancestor). drift-layer.js:24 reports depth via window.bunkiDriftDepth; corridor.js:1099-1104 sets S.driftDepth and toggles body.drift-dived. corridor.css:313-317: body.ginga.drift-dived #drift-layer #hint { display:block !important } re-reveals the 水にふれると戻る hint. Nav back arrow armed: corridor.js:11194 backB.disabled = !S.stack.length && S.view==='drift' && !S.driftDepth, and navBackFromGinga (11054-11061) surfaces one level via window.bunkiDriftSurface when S.driftDepth > 0.

findings.title: Galaxy nav search results collapse to 71px input width
findings.evidence: Commit 792bb66 (ancestor). corridor.css:561-570: .nav-search-results is now position:absolute anchored to the bar with left:0; right:0 (spans the full bar, comment cites the P1 review finding), max-height 46vh with overflow-y auto. Same commit also fixed the truncated placeholder.

findings.title: Shelf corpus wikinews-1403 text corrupted by link-stripping
findings.evidence: Commit 2c72ab9 (ancestor) restored the three stripped country names: current data/articles/wikinews-1403.json reads 「危機遺産リストから取り消されたのは、エクアドルのサンガイ国立公園、マリのトンブクトゥ、アルバニアのブトリントである。」— the dangling-の defect is gone; index.json chars re-pinned 1220→1237.
findings.note: The ledger's second, 'likely lost を' item was NOT repaired: current text still reads 「日本の知床半島（北海道）含め」 (no を before 含め), matching the suspected link-stripping loss. Minor, but the finding is not fully closed.

findings.title: Dictionary homograph rows replace stack top instead of pushing
findings.evidence: Commit 952dbc7 (ancestor). corridor.js:8297-8315: homograph choice handler now does S.stack.push({t:'word', id:headForm, seq, reading, from}) — comment states 'a homograph is a DOOR, not a correction: it PUSHES, so ← 戻る returns to the entry the learner was reading'. Also guards by content, not object identity, against async stack-top replacement.

findings.title: Back from deeper dictionary page rerenders parent at scrollTop 0
findings.evidence: Commit 34c0176 (ancestor). corridor.js:10300-10310: sheet scroll is tracked continuously via a passive listener onto the stack-top node (node.sheetScroll = sheet.scrollTop) and restored on return with requestAnimationFrame (10308). Stroke-room round-trips restore via S.sheetScrollRestore (corridor.js:2286-2328, 10339-10342). New pushes still open at top by design (homograph handler resets live.scrollTop = 0).

findings.title: Writing room awake field ignores operator corner anatomy
findings.evidence: Commit 7c75643 (四隅の間 L2, ancestor). corridor.js:9086-9089 documents the anatomy: worlds top-right on the seal, numbers bottom-right, speed bottom-left, back top-left, readings underneath the glyph. Implemented: numbersCorner gets classes stroke-corner stroke-corner-br (corridor.js:10045), speedCorner stroke-corner-bl (10048); corridor.css:3836-3841 positions .stroke-corner-br / -bl; world seal is the top-right corner and answers while sleeping (corridor.js:9757-9758); wake mark opens only the readings under the glyph (9090-9103).

findings.title: Hidden legacy S.strokeSlow preference silently applies with no UI
findings.evidence: Same commit lineage (7c75643 / 88eb3ad, ancestors). corridor.js:9107-9120: strokeSpeedControl — the visible ゆっくり bottom-left corner control — surfaces the stored preference (aria-pressed reflects S.strokeSlow), toggles it, and live-rewrites the ink (inkRoom.handle.rewrite(strokeRewriteOptions()) where speed = S.strokeSlow ? 0.7 : 1.1, corridor.js:9290). A second slow toggle exists on the non-minimal page at 9953-9956. The preference is now visible and undoable everywhere it applies.

findings.title: 覚える never top-right, 2000px deep, absent from most screens
findings.evidence: Commits 48fd950 (stage 1: top-right on every sheet) and 3e62d90 (stage 3: grammar/particles capturable), both ancestors. corridor.js:10254-10270: every sheet whose node type is in NODE_KIND gets a persistent 覚 button in the sheet top bar (margin-left:auto → top-right, corridor.css:2260-2276), aria-pressed toggle. NODE_KIND (corridor.js:5908-5918) now includes word, kanji, radical, idiom, grammar, particle — grammar/particle capture exists.
findings.note: The core defect (bottom-of-flow, ~2000px deep, sheet-only word/kanji) is fixed: capture is top-right, one tap, on all six capturable sheet types. But the operator directive '覚える on every screen' is still only met at sheet level: the long-press mini (corridor.js:2945-2977), the reader/shelf surfaces, and the stroke room still have no direct capture affordance — the mini path is mini → 全項目 → top-right 覚 (2 extra taps).

findings.title: Grade hanko row lands below the fold on tall answer faces
findings.evidence: Commit 42b54d6 (ancestor). corridor.css:5062-5076: body.zen .grade-row is now position:sticky; bottom:0; z-index:3 with washi background (var(--ground-0)) and top shadow — comment explicitly cites the P1 finding ('top 1137 in an 844px viewport'). The four seals stay in reach while the answer face scrolls beneath.

findings.title: Capture is a one-way door: no un-memorize, no list delete/rename
findings.evidence: Commits 48fd950 ('it swings both ways') and bcf7f47 ('lists are born, renamed, and released'), both ancestors. Un-memorize: toggleTaken (corridor.js:6013-6017) removes the item from S.taken when already taken; takeButton (6019-6035) shows 覚える ✓ — やめる with aria-pressed and toggles; the sheet-bar 覚 button (10266-10269) uses the same toggle with 覚えるをやめる label. Lists: the lists surface has an inline create field with dupe/empty validation feedback (corridor.js:3697-3716, no window.prompt no-op), per-list rename (✎, inline field, 3736-3742 + 3773-3801) and two-tap armed delete (× → 消す？ with 3.2s disarm, 3744-3769) that deletes only curation, never items' taken status.

findings.title: Galaxy → tutor crumb/back (先生 from drift claims 'bookshelf › tutor', back lands on shelf)
findings.anchors: prototypes/corridor/corridor.js:11225-11233 (sensei bubble sets S.view='ai' with no origin recorded), 11302-11306 (crumb: any non-entry/drift view pushes 本棚 first), 2222-2249 (back(): view 'ai' falls into the shelf branch → S.view='shelf')
findings.evidence: The 先生 corner-bubble handler still only does S.view='ai'; the crumb builder still prefixes 本棚 for view 'ai' regardless of where the user came from, and back() for 'ai' still lands on the shelf (S.view='shelf', line 2245). The dojo asymmetry persists: back() from 'dojo' returns to 'drift' (lines 2203-2207). No commit since the ledger touches this path.

findings.title: Galaxy bloom ring ignores 390px viewport; edge satellites clipped/offscreen
findings.anchors: prototypes/corridor/drift-layer.js:1078-1086 (ring: r=(118|196 + hash%38)/cam.z around the planet, no viewport clamp), 1071-1076 (only mitigation: camera glide, and only when stack.length===0)
findings.evidence: Satellite placement is still pure polar math with no screen-bounds clamping; a 196+px radius on a 390px viewport still pushes edge satellites offscreen. drift-layer.js has only three commits since the ledger (02188af, ac880af, 4032235 — P0 judgment bridge, chrome-tap exemption, dive exit); none touch the bloom ring.

findings.title: Galaxy nav search placeholder truncated to 'searc' at 71px
findings.evidence: Commit 792bb66 ('galaxy nav: search results span the bar, placeholder fits its field'). The placeholder is now '検索' (fits at any width) with a bilingual aria-label (corridor.js:11095), and .nav-search-results anchors to the full bar (corridor.css:561-580, with an in-code comment citing the review finding).

findings.title: Reader long-press: release click lands on 全項目 spawning under the finger, skipping the mini

The token-actions pill no longer appears on press-driven focus, so no button materializes under the finger; the mini also removes any visible pill when it opens.

findings.title: Token-actions pill pops over prose after every tap; doubles 全項目 beside the long-press mini
findings.anchors: prototypes/corridor/corridor.js:3030-3054 (press-recency gate keeps the pill for keyboard/switch/screen-reader focus only), 2944-2949 (mini removes lingering pills)

findings.title: すべて仮名 dial converts katakana loanwords/proper nouns to hiragana

findings.title: Nested buttons: details-toggle <button> inside shelf-item <button>

findings.title: Sheet discoverability: 用例 eyebrow never says hold opens the dictionary; 覚える ✓ silently un-undoable

findings.title: World-stone labels: 8px names in the writing room, 神奈川沖浪裏 ellipsizes

findings.title: Article schema: 0 of 764 articles carry an English title; no titleEn key

findings.evidence: srsDueItems still builds reviews/fresh by walking S.taken in capture order and applies no overdueness (or any) sort before returning. The function moved from ~5661 to 6314 but its ordering logic is unchanged.

findings.title: Two AI stacks: @bunki/ai's envelopes/ceilings/telemetry serve zero deployed traffic
